why: A September 2026 preprint by Zhi-Wei Sun (arXiv:2609.04176) claims to prove Catalan's constant, one of the constants named in this bullet, is irrational; a linked GitHub Lean formalization attempt explicitly states it 'does not claim G irrational' for the fragment formalized so far, indicating the proof is unverified/contested. Other constants in the bullet (gamma, Khinchin's constant) still show no proof of irrationality as of the searches.
